homily:
Cinga ngendlela ibali eliqala ngayo apha phantsi kwelanga. KwiNcwadi kaGalati, uPawulos ubhala ngamazwi abukhali kakhulu, engena ngqo kwintliziyo yendaba: 'O Galati abaziziyatha! Ngubani unikwe ubungqina obucacileyo bukaYesu Kristu obetshwe emnqamlezweni?' Uthi abantu bazama ukufumana ubulungisa ngemisebenzi yomthetho, ngokusenza izinto ngezandla zabo, ngokuqokelela amanyathelo okuzama ukuzenza basinde emehlweni kaThixo. Kodwa uPawulos usikhumbuza into ehlukeneyo kakhulu. Uthi: 'Kuba bonke abaxhomekeke emisebenzini yomthetho bangaphantsi kwesiqalekiso… Lowo ulilungisa ngokholo uyakuphila.' Apha kukho umfanekiso wokuma phambi kweengcango ezivaliweyo. Ucinga ukuba kufuneka ufake isitshixo esifanelekileyo, ukuba kufuneka wenze konke ngendlela egqibeleleyo ukuze ukhusele abantwana bakho, ukuze ukhusele ikhaya lakho kwiingozi zehlabathi.

Kodwa uYesu kwiVangeli ka-Luka ubonisa enye inyaniso enkulu, esoyikisayo ngamanye amaxesha, kodwa ekugqibeleni ikhanyisa bonke ubumnyama. Abantu bathetha ngaye bathi ukhupha iidemon ngamandla kaBhelezebuli. Bafuna umqondiso ovela phezulu. UYesu uyabazi abacinga ngako, ube esithi: 'Xa umntu owomeleleyo exhobileyo egada indlu yakhe, izinto zakhe zikhuselekile. Kodwa xa kufika ongaphezulu kunaye, amoyise, amhlwithe izixhobo zakhe ebekholose ngazo, aze ahlulele impahla yakhe.' Lo ngumfanekiso womqhusheko omkhulu wamandla amabini. Kukho amandla obumnyama afuna ukubamba ikhaya lakho, afuna ukubamba ingqondo yakho ngokuzisola nangokoyika; kwaye kukho lowo omeleleyo kakhulu owaphula olo donga lweentlungu, oza kuzisa ukukhanya apho kwakukho isithokothoko.

Masimi apha ixesha elincinci… Masicinge ngoBenjamin Vo, ngaloo ntwana owayenentliziyo eqaqambileyo eyayiqonda izinto ezininzi zenzululwazi nezobuchwephesha. Wayeyazi indlela yokwakha ikhowudi, indlela yokucinga ngamaphupha amakhulu okubhabha, kwaye wayethanda ukuhleka xa encokola ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe. UBenjamin wayengumntwana owayengafuni kubonwa ngabantu nje, kodwa owayenomdla wokwazi inyaniso yezinto. Khumbula indlela awayephila ngayo – engakhathali ngokuzibonakalisa, kodwa enika uthando lwakhe ngokupheleleyo. Ngekhe siwulibale umzuzu awayefuna ngayo yonke intliziyo yakhe ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam, ngaphandle kokuba aphule ibhokisi yakhe encinci yemali, kodwa ngokumnikela konke oko akunakho entliziyweni yakhe.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesithathu emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, kukho iingcamango eziza kuwe ebusuku ezikubuza ukuba: 'Kutheni kukho intlungu enjengale? Kutheni le ntwana inobubele obungaka yahamba ngolu hlobo?' Ucinga ngaloo miba yokugula, mhlawumbi uzibek’ icala ngokwakho, uzibuza ukuba ngaba uphosile na inyathelo elithile, ngaba ukhona umntu owenza impazamo. Ndifuna ukuba ume apha, uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo enovelwano olukhulu. KwiVangeli, uYesu akaze abeke icala kubazali bomntu owayegula. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungaphelekiyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

Kwaye nangu umkhanya oza kukhanyisa indlu yakho namhlanje. UYesu uthi: 'Ukuba ke ndikhupha iidemon ngomunwe kaThixo, uBukumkani bukaThixo bufikile kuni.' Lomunwe kaThixo ngumsebenzi wobubele bakhe obungagungqiyo. Awusodwa kuloo mthwalo. UBen akalahlekanga; usebukhoneni obukhulu boMthombo wothando. Kwiimbono zakho zasebusuku, kwiintsuku ezinzima xa ungazilindelanga, khumbula ukuba uthando alufa. UBen uyaqhubeka ekhanya, engumthombo woxolo njengalowo wamanzi eCà Mau oletha ubomi kwabanye.

Ryan, mfowethu omncane, uBen uyaqhubeka ehamba nawe. Ungalokothi uzive ungedwa. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngezinto ezinkulu, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu Kristu, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente Eyingcwele yaseAltar. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwezinto zonke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukuba nawe emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukwamkela kwiSakramente, nceda uze emphefumlweni wam ngendlela yomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ufikile, ndihlasele kuwe ngokupheleleyo; musa ukundivumela ukuba ndahlukane nawe nanini na. Amen.
closing: Ngamana uxolo lukaThixo olugqithisa konke ukuqonda lungalondoloza iintliziyo zenu namhlanje naphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sikhulekela umntwana uBenjamin nabanye bonke abaswelekileyo, ukuba baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu naphezulu.
Sikhulekela bonke abasebenza usizi nentsizi, ukuba uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba elingenakufa.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuQala
readings.text: Bazalwane, qaphelani ukuba ngabo banokholo abangabantwana bakaAbraham. Isibhalo, esabona kwangaphambili ukuba uThixo angabalungisa iintlanga ngokholo, sashumayela iindaba ezilungileyo kuAbraham, sisithi: 'Ngawakho zonke iintlanga ziya kusikelelwa.' Ngako oko, abo banokholo basikelelwa kunye noAbraham owaba nokholo. Kuba bonke abaxhomekeke emisebenzini yomthetho bangaphantsi kwesiqalekiso; kuba kubhaliwe kwathiwa: 'Cikidekile bonke abanganyamezeliyo ekwenzeni zonke izinto ezibhaliweyo encwadini yomthetho.' Nokuba akukho namnye olungiswe phambi kukaThixo ngumthetho, kuyacaca; kuba lowo ulilungisa ngokholo uyakuphila. Kodwa umthetho awuxhomekekanga ngokholo; kunoko, lowo uzenzayo ezo zinto uyakuphila ngazo. UKristu usikhulule kwisiqalekiso somthetho ngokuba ngesiqalekiso ngenxa yethu, kuba kubhaliwe kwathiwa: 'Cikidekile bonke abaxhonywe emthini,' ukuze isuke isikelelo sikaAbraham size kwiintlanga ngoKristu Yesu, ukuze samkele isithembiso soMoya ngokholo.

readings.text:
R. INkosi iyakukhumbula uncedo lwayo ngonaphakade.
Ndiyabulela kuYehova ngentliziyo yam yonke, ebandleni nasentlanganisweni yamalungisa. Masebenzi mankulu kaYehova, aziswe ngabo bonke abakholisayo kuwo.
R. INkosi iyakukhumbula uncedo lwayo ngonaphakade.
Isidima nobukhosi ngumsebenzi wakhe, ubulungisa bakhe buhleli ngonaphakade. Uenze isikhumbuzo semiqondiso yakhe emangalisayo; unobubele nenceba uYehova.
R. INkosi iyakukhumbula uncedo lwayo ngonaphakade.
Unike ukudla kwabo bamoyikayo; uyakhumbula ngonaphakade umnqophiso wakhe. Ubuyityhile kubantu bakhe amandla emisebenzi yakhe, ebanika ilifa leentlanga.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: Ngelixa uYesu wakhuphayo idemon, abanye abantu esixukwini bathi: 'Ngamandla kaBhelezebuli, umphathi weedemon, ukhupha ngayo iidemon.' Abanye, ukumlinga, bafuna kuye umqondiso ovela phezulu. Ke yena esazi iingcamango zabo wathi kubo: 'Yonke uBukumkani eyahlulene yodwa iyatshabalala, indlu iwa phezu kwendlu. Ukuba uSathana wahlulene yedwa, wobume njani uBukumkani bakhe? Kuba nithi ndikhipha iidemon ngoBhelezebuli. Kodwa ukuba ndikhipha iidemon ngoBhelezebuli, abantwana benu bazikhipha ngobani na? Ngenxa yalo nto baya kuba ngabagwebi benu. Ke ukuba ndikhipha iidemon ngomunwe kaThixo, ngoko uBukumkani bukaThixo bufikile kuni. Xa umntu omeleleyo exhobileyo egada indlu yakhe, izinto zakhe zikhuselekile. Kodwa xa kufika ongaphezulu kunaye, amoyise, amhlwithe izixhobo zakhe ebekholose ngazo, aze ahlulele impahla yakhe. Oyingenaso nam nam, uchasene nam; kwaye ocingiweyo nam, uyachitha. Xa umoya ongcolileyo uphumile kumntu, uzulazula ezindaweni ezingenamanzi, ufuna ukuphumula; kungafuneki nto, uthi: 'Ndiya kubuyela endlwini yam endiphume kuyo.' Uthi akufika ayifumane itshiziwe, ilungisiwe. Ake ahambe aze athathe abanye omoya abasixhenxe ababi kunaye, bangene bahlale apho; abe ke umntu loyo okokugqibela embi kunasekuqaleni.'

day: Friday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.text: Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben
